name: File Manager UI quality and features

description: Baseline: File Manager at default size (72x20). Plain directory listing, no markdown preview, monochrome icons, minimal chrome. All axes below 6.

Responsive sizing (85% screen), directory preview with contents listing, file type icons (ts/js/md/json-specific), file sizes in list, JSON pretty-print, markdown rendering via renderMarkdownFile. Fixed directory crash.
Breadcrumb navigation in toolbar, total file size in status bar, docs/ folder with md files visible. Readability and coherence improved.

Tags enabled on preview pane. Coloured directory preview: cyan dir icons, green file bullets, bold headers, coloured overflow counts. Coloured line numbers (gray) for code/text files. Escaped braces in content.
